claims: SpaceX successfully launched two separate Falcon 9 missions on April 14, 2026.
Starlink 10-24 launched at 5:33 a.m. EDT from Florida’s Cape Canaveral Space Force Station on April 14, 2026.
Starlink 17-27 launched from California's Vandenberg Space Force Base on April 14, 2026.
The booster for Starlink 10-24 landed on the Just Read the Instructions droneship.
Starlink 17-27 launch followed a Sunday scrub.
The booster for Starlink 17-27 landed on the Of Course I Still Love You drone ship.
Over 1,000 Starlink satellites were already launched in 2026 as of April 14.
The booster for the Starlink 10-24 mission was on its 26th flight.
The booster for the Starlink 17-27 mission was on its 21st flight.
